title: HtmlSemanticRequestV1
description: Collect DOM order, visual geometry and keyboard focus order of a vetted static HTML source in the isolated renderer. Read-only.

chromiumSandbox.description: Start Chromium with its own sandbox (needs unprivileged user namespaces on the host). Absent or false: Playwright's default, which runs Chromium with --no-sandbox, as required in AWS Lambda and default Docker.
